subject: Interactive API enablement — office hours and sandbox access
messages:

Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finz.com>

Subject: Request: interactive API enablement office hours for engineering team

Hi Sean and Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team found the console walkthrough useful. Our backend engineers asked for a short, hands-on office hours session focused on API integration and sandbox troubleshooting (30–45 mins). Goal: get a small group unblocked on token handling, streaming, and KV cache expectations so they can hit their integration milestone.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 5, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Oct 6, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Oct 7, 08:30–09:15

We prefer the Tue or Wed options. Attendees will be myself, Marta (engineering), and two backend devs (Nadia and Pri). I can send a calendar invite once we confirm. Also: is there a short prework checklist we can push to the devs?

Thanks,
Alex

Director of Engineering | Finz
alex.rivera@finz.com

Hi Alex — great to hear the demo landed well. Tue Oct 5 10:00 PDT works for us; I can lead the API portion and Camila can cover console-level troubleshooting. Monica is copied to help with sandbox credential handoff and to share a short prework checklist.

Quick plan:
- 10:00–10:10: quick goals + mapping (Sean)
- 10:10–10:30: API deep dive + streaming example (Sean)
- 10:30–10:40: sandbox access & live repro (Monica)
- 10:40–10:45: next steps / follow-ups (Camila)

Can you confirm attendees' emails (Nadia and Pri) so we can add them to the calendar? I attached a 1-page prework checklist — if you can ask the devs to complete the token-check and sample curl before the session, we'll be able to spend more time on streaming edge cases.

I'll wait for your confirm and then send a calendar invite with a short join doc and the prework.

Cheers,
Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep for Finz office hours (Tue 10/5 10:00 PDT)

Camila / Monica — quick internal prep so we're aligned before Tuesday.

1) Materials: I updated the enablement deck to add a short streaming snippet and a KV cache troubleshooting slide (enablement-deck-v2.pdf). Camila, can you add a 2–3 minute live demo of the Console network tab to show request/response timing? Monica, please be prepared to provision the sandbox creds ahead of time and have the runbook (sandbox-access-runbook.md) ready to paste into chat if needed.

2) Roles: I'll handle the API examples and live code (Node + curl). Camila will drive the Console walkthrough and post-session follow-ups. Monica will own granting access and verifying the devs can hit the sandbox from their CI.

3) Logistics: We'll join via the Redwood meeting link, but Camila — if you prefer to use a recorded session for the console demo, flag now and I'll disable recording for the live repro portion. Also, let's open a shared Google Doc for live notes and a short action list so Finz has a reference after the call.

If either of you sees a blocker, call me directly. I'll upload the deck and runbook to the shared folder and paste links in the calendar event.

Thanks — Sean
